phase: Phase 3: End-to-End Feature Validation and Risk-Analysis Verification

status_legend.PASS: Verified by appropriate automated end-to-end evidence.
status_legend.PARTIAL: Some paths pass but live provider integration, durability, or edge cases remain unverified.
status_legend.BLOCKED: Unavailable environment or external dependency prevents test execution.
status_legend.NOT_IMPLEMENTED: Capability does not exist in current codebase.

features.name: System Health and Readiness Verification
features.processing_engine: FastAPI health check & database ping
features.missing_validation_scenarios: None

features.name: Authoritative Synchronous URL Risk Analysis
features.processing_engine: OrchestratorService -> RiskEngine (URLNormalizer, StaticAnalyzer, ReputationAnalyzer) -> ExplanationGenerator
features.external_dependencies: Google Safe Browsing, VirusTotal, Google GenAI (Gemini)
features.persistence_behavior: Persists ScanRecord, Evidence, Findings, RiskAssessment via ScanRepository
features.missing_validation_scenarios: Live credential queries against external threat providers (unauthorized/prohibited)

features.name: Authoritative Multimodal Content Analysis
features.input_formats: application/json {input_type: str, raw_payload: str/bytes, metadata: dict}
features.processing_engine: OrchestratorService -> MultimodalPipeline (OCR/CV, QR, PDF, Text Scanners) -> RiskEngine
features.external_dependencies: Tesseract OCR, PyZBar, PyPDF, Gemini Provider
features.persistence_behavior: Persists ScanRecord, Evidence, Findings, RiskAssessment via ScanRepository
features.missing_validation_scenarios: Native Tesseract binary validation (host lacks Tesseract executable)

features.name: Scan Lifecycle Creation and Submission
features.input_formats: application/json or multipart/form-data with sync query parameter
features.processing_engine: FastAPI route -> OrchestratorService (sync) or in-process background worker (async)
features.missing_validation_scenarios: Multi-worker distributed task queue (currently in-process asyncio)

features.name: Scan Detail Retrieval and Anti-Enumeration
features.authentication: Bearer JWT (Scan Owner or Service Role)
features.processing_engine: ScanRepository.get_scan_by_id
features.missing_validation_scenarios: None (returns 404 for non-existent and unowned scans)

features.name: Paginated Scan History Listing
features.input_formats: Query params: limit, offset, status, min_severity
features.processing_engine: ScanRepository.list_scans
features.persistence_behavior: Read-only paginated query filtered by user_id
features.missing_validation_scenarios: None

features.name: Scan Feedback Submission
features.input_formats: application/json {rating: str, comment: str, false_positive: bool}
features.processing_engine: ScanRepository.add_feedback
features.missing_validation_scenarios: None

features.name: Scan Cascade Deletion and GDPR Purge
features.authentication: Bearer JWT (Scan Owner or Service Role)
features.processing_engine: ScanRepository.delete_scan
features.persistence_behavior: Cascades deletion across Tasks, Findings, Evidence, and Assessment
features.missing_validation_scenarios: None

features.name: Stuck Scan Reconciliation & Quota Refund
features.processing_engine: OrchestratorService.reconcile_stuck_scans
features.persistence_behavior: Marks stale scans FAILED and refunds reserved user quotas
features.missing_validation_scenarios: Cross-node leader election during reconciliation

features.name: Automated Maintenance and Retention Pruning
features.processing_engine: RetentionService.purge_expired_records
features.persistence_behavior: Deletes records older than retention window and unlinks stored artifacts
features.missing_validation_scenarios: S3/GCS remote object store artifact unlinking

features.name: Deterministic Risk Scoring Engine
features.input_formats: Normalized URL, Extracted Indicators, Evidence objects
features.processing_engine: Multiplicative non-linear risk accumulator with Critical/High severity floors
features.persistence_behavior: Returns ephemeral SecurityReport for upstream persistence
features.missing_validation_scenarios: None

features.name: External Threat Reputation Intelligence
features.processing_engine: GoogleSafeBrowsingProvider, VirusTotalProvider with async cache and bounded timeout
features.external_dependencies: Google Safe Browsing v4, VirusTotal v3
features.missing_validation_scenarios: Live paid/credentialed quota enforcement against upstream Google/VT APIs

features.name: Screenshot and Image OCR Pipeline
features.processing_engine: OpenCV visual quality / contrast analysis + Tesseract fallback engine
features.persistence_behavior: Temporary buffer during scan lifecycle, purged after extraction
features.missing_validation_scenarios: Host missing system Tesseract binary (falls back safely with limitation indicator)

features.name: QR Code Target Extraction and Deep Scan
features.processing_engine: OpenCV QRCodeDetector / pyzbar -> Recursive URL validation
features.persistence_behavior: Ephemeral extraction passed to downstream URL analysis
features.missing_validation_scenarios: Multiple QR targets in a single frame (detects primary)

features.name: PDF Document Payload and Link Intelligence
features.processing_engine: PyPDF parser -> text extraction + Annots URI extraction -> URLNormalizer
features.persistence_behavior: Ephemeral extraction passed to downstream URL analysis
features.missing_validation_scenarios: Password-protected and encrypted PDF fuzzing

features.name: Suspicious Message & Scam Language Classifier
features.processing_engine: Lexical heuristics matching urgency, financial lures, prize scams, credential harvest
features.missing_validation_scenarios: Multilingual scam corpus (currently English-centric)

features.name: Adversarial Prompt Injection Defense
features.processing_engine: Pattern match against instruction overrides, jailbreaks, delimiter escaping
features.missing_validation_scenarios: Dynamic evasion using novel unicode homoglyph obfuscation in prompts

features.name: LLM Explanation Layer with Non-Override Guardrail
features.processing_engine: GeminiProvider / Google GenAI SDK with structured Pydantic ExplanationOutput
features.missing_validation_scenarios: Live Google GenAI API rate limit backoff (tested via unit mocks)

features.name: Local Gemma Fallback Provider
features.processing_engine: Ollama local inference daemon
features.external_dependencies: Ollama daemon running locally with Gemma model weights
features.existing_test_coverage: Unit test stubs with mock responses
features.missing_validation_scenarios: Local inference on host lacking Ollama daemon

features.name: Tenant Quota Management & Atomic Reservations
features.processing_engine: Atomic count checking, daily reservation, and rollback refunds on error
features.persistence_behavior: Persists quota usage counters per day
features.missing_validation_scenarios: Distributed multi-region quota consistency across read replicas

features.name: Process-Local In-Memory Rate Limiter
features.processing_engine: Sliding window in-memory rate limiter
features.missing_validation_scenarios: Horizontal cluster rate synchronization (Redis not yet implemented)

features.name: Cryptographic JWT Authentication & Claims Validation
features.processing_engine: PyJWT decoding with HS256, expiration check, issuer check
features.missing_validation_scenarios: RS256 asymmetric JWKS live key rotation from Supabase auth endpoint

features.name: Cross-User Isolation & Anti-Enumeration Defense
features.processing_engine: ScanRepository strict user_id query filtering; returns 404 on unowned UUID
features.missing_validation_scenarios: None

features.name: User Impersonation Prevention
features.processing_engine: Enforces user_id derived exclusively from validated JWT claims, ignoring body/header overrides
features.missing_validation_scenarios: None

features.name: Service-Role Privileged Access Boundary
features.processing_engine: Role-based authorization filter (requires service_role)
features.missing_validation_scenarios: Granular scoped RBAC permissions (e.g. read-only admin vs full admin)

features.name: Server-Side Request Forgery (SSRF) Defense
features.processing_engine: NetworkPolicy.is_ip_allowed filtering against RFC 1918, RFC 3927, loopbacks, cloud metadata
features.missing_validation_scenarios: DNS rebinding protection during live outbound HTTP resolution

features.name: Local Sandbox Execution Invariant
features.processing_engine: Config validation enforcing SAFE_LOCAL_SANDBOX_ENABLED=False
features.missing_validation_scenarios: None

features.name: In-Process Async Scan Task Processing
features.processing_engine: asyncio.create_task in-process background worker
features.persistence_behavior: Updates TaskRecord status from PENDING -> PROCESSING -> COMPLETED/FAILED
features.missing_validation_scenarios: Durable queueing under process crash/restart (documented architectural limitation)

features.name: Relational Audit Event Logging
features.processing_engine: AuditLog database insertion
features.missing_validation_scenarios: Append-only tamper-evident cryptographic hash chaining for audit records

features.name: PostgreSQL Staging Gate & Migration Safety
features.processing_engine: SQLAlchemy PostgreSQL dialect
features.persistence_behavior: PostgreSQL schema initialization and transaction commit
features.missing_validation_scenarios: Live execution against real PostgreSQL instance
